liquid.description: Liquid hydrogen storage stations - costs by capacity

deployment_probability_config.description: Probability of deployment per year varies by project status, up to max_delay_years

status_definitions.operational: Station is currently operational and dispensing hydrogen
status_definitions.under construction: Station construction has started, expected to open in planned year
status_definitions.FID: Final Investment Decision approved, financing secured, construction imminent
status_definitions.project development: Project in development phase, permits and financing being arranged
status_definitions.in planning: Early planning stage, feasibility studies and site selection ongoing

status_model_implications.operational: Already operational. This station is included in all simulations from the planned year onward with 100% certainty. It contributes immediately to hydrogen supply capacity.
status_model_implications.under construction: 90% deployment probability per year. In each simulation year (up to 4 years after planned year), this station has a 90% chance to become operational. High likelihood of deployment contributes to more optimistic infrastructure scenarios.
status_model_implications.FID: 80% deployment probability per year. With financing secured, this station has an 80% chance per year (up to 4 years after planned year) to become operational. Moderately high likelihood impacts both optimistic and realistic scenarios.
status_model_implications.project development: 50% deployment probability per year. In the development phase, this station has a 50% chance per year (up to 4 years after planned year) to become operational. Creates significant variation across simulation runs.
status_model_implications.in planning: 30% deployment probability per year. Early-stage planning means only a 30% chance per year (up to 4 years after planned year) to become operational. Contributes mainly to optimistic scenarios and increases uncertainty.
